title: Team Onboarding 🚀
content:
# 👋 Welcome to the team!

Glad to have you aboard. Here's your first week at a glance:

## ✅ Day 1 — Setup
- Get your accounts: **Tracker**, **Wiki**, Calendar
- Say hi in **#team-general**

## 📚 Day 2–3 — Ramp up
- Skim the architecture docs
- Pair with your onboarding buddy

## 🚀 Day 4–5 — Ship
- Grab a starter task from the **DEMO** queue
- Open your first pull request!

> 💡 Stuck on anything? Ask anyone — we're here to help.
